scene: The opened crate disgorges three transit tokens at the bustling central terminal. Which ride?
picture: Along a polished concourse, a yellow street tram waits on the far left. The young Black woman in yellow raincoat and green boots stands mid-left holding her red umbrella and glowing tokens. An open cable car cabin hangs up high centre. A ticketing kiosk stands right, and illuminated subway stairs wait far right.
shown: a yellow street tram idling with open doors on the far left
an orange cable car cabin suspended from a cable up high centre
a glowing neon stairway sign pointing down to the subway on the far right
